purpose: Centralize the non-fish formal content inputs that still block DeliveryHarnessAssets, without splitting presentation, expression unlocks, imprint admission, growth Buffs, fatigue presentation, or yellow-stamina presentation into separately closable tasks. Gameplay equipment unlock gates, TheftCaught as a mandatory imprint, poison/FoodSafety, herb recovery, and pure detox rest are superseded by the 2026-09-14 user decision and must not be reintroduced as current blockers.

gap_list.available_fact: The human progress entry records DataWorldProfileAlbum and CharacterGrowthCondition as engineering-complete but not formally content-complete, notes that BodyAction long-action Montage assets and config now have clean machine evidence, and keeps DeliveryHarnessAssets blocked by formal GameplayCue/final presentation plus progress/growth content decisions.

technical_plan.available_fact: The technical plan records the same product/content boundaries after the 2026-09-14 cleanup: expression unlock milestones, imprint admission, Buff choices, fatigue presentation, yellow-stamina boundaries, BodyAction formal GameplayCue/final player-visible presentation resources, and broader player-visible presentation resources remain open inputs rather than engineering facts; BodyAction formal Montage assets/config are now generated and load-verified. Poison/FoodSafety, herb recovery, pure detox rest, TheftCaught mandatory imprint, and gameplay equipment unlock gates are no longer current requirements.

release_handoff.available_fact: DeliveryReleaseHandoffPackage already carries FormalPresentationBoundaryFreeze and FormalProgressGrowthContentFreeze as remaining input contracts under one DeliveryHarnessAssets release surface.

harness_contract.available_fact: DeliveryHarnessAssets is a single atomic module; formal presentation and progress/growth content blockers must remain module-level Delivery inputs instead of scattered subtasks.

upgrade_effect_doc.title: 升级效果
upgrade_effect_doc.available_fact: The live document is the stated source for the current three-choice growth Buff catalog, including player-facing copy, effects, values, stacking notes, and appearance order.
upgrade_effect_doc.blocking_fact: The same document says all values are snapshots pending playtest, so it narrows the growth-Buff gap but does not by itself freeze formal growth content.

imprint_album_doc.title: 印记图鉴
imprint_album_doc.available_fact: The live imprint album source historically confirmed TheftCaught as a must-enter imprint event for both involved players and lists candidate trigger families for fishing, social, fish-album, character/state, environment, equipment/items, camp, and self-photo moments.
imprint_album_doc.blocking_fact: The 2026-09-14 user decision deletes the theft protocol and TheftCaught mandatory imprint from current gates. The remaining blocker is the formal permanent Imprint admission list for retained non-theft events.

titles: 裁决同步 · 装备与商店（王甜甜）
equipment_unlock_context.available_fact: The equipment sources describe unlock as shop shelving or ceremony context and show that the earlier cumulative-30-fish rod unlock was removed in favor of public-fund purchase.
equipment_unlock_context.blocking_fact: The 2026-09-14 user decision removes gameplay equipment unlock gates from current requirements. Expression/appearance unlock content still needs formal milestone mapping when it is in scope.

A product decision that native debug text, raw state labels, and internal asset names are not visible on the formal player path.

Full retained imprint admission list, excluding the deleted TheftCaught theft protocol event, including which run events can create permanent Imprint grants.
Formal growth Buff choices, numeric effects, and player-facing copy for PendingChoiceCount consumption; the current 升级效果 source narrows this but still needs formal acceptance or playtest freeze.

Formal yellow-stamina shield presentation and consumption boundary.

Do not mark CharacterGrowthCondition formally complete from ASC and Growth automation while Buff, fatigue, or yellow-stamina content is still open.
Do not split expression UnlockId, imprint admission, Buff, fatigue, and yellow-stamina decisions into separate DeliveryHarnessAssets subtasks.

close_rule: This package can move to ready only when both content_groups are satisfied with authoritative product/content facts and package_blocking_gaps is empty. It does not close DeliveryHarnessAssets by itself; Delivery still also requires RunEnvironmentSocial module behavior evidence and passing Static plus AssetReadiness verification.
